01 · The first 50

The first fifty,
as the widget deals them

HSK 2 adds 147 new words on top of HSK 1, which brings the running total to about 300. These are the words of simple daily exchanges: shopping, directions, the weather, plans for the weekend. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 2 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 of the words above, in a sentence.

打篮球

dǎ lánqiú

to play basketball

我喜欢和朋友一起打篮球。

Wǒ xǐhuān hé péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎ lánqiú.

I like playing basketball with my friends.

向

Xiàng

towards; to (in the direction of)

请一直向前走。

Qǐng yīzhí xiàng qián zǒu.

Please walk straight ahead.

鱼

yú

fish

我在商店买了三条鱼。

Wǒ zài shāngdiàn mǎile sān tiáo yú.

I bought three fish at the store.

鸡蛋

jīdàn

chicken egg

我早上喜欢吃一个鸡蛋。

Wǒ zǎoshang xǐhuān chī yī gè jīdàn.

I like to eat an egg in the morning.

走

zǒu

to walk or go

我们一起走去商店。

Wǒmen yīqǐ zǒu qù shāngdiàn.

Let's walk to the store together.

贵

guì

expensive

这件衣服太贵了。

Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì le.

This piece of clothing is too expensive.

大家

dàjiā

everyone

大家都在饭馆吃饭。

Dàjiā dōu zài fànguǎn chīfàn.

Everyone is eating at the restaurant.

已经

yǐjīng

already

我作业已经做完了。

Wǒ zuòyè yǐjīng zuò wán le.

I have already finished my homework.

起床

qǐchuáng

to get up

我每天早上七点起床。

Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.

I get up at seven every morning.

时间

shíjiān

time

我没有时间去商店。

Wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān qù shāngdiàn.

I do not have time to go to the store.

可能

kěnéng

might or possible

明天可能会下雨。

Míngtiān kěnéng huì xiàyǔ.

It might rain tomorrow.

所以

suǒyǐ

therefore or so

因为下雨了，所以我没去学校。

Yīnwèi xiàyǔ le, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù xuéxiào.

It was raining, so I did not go to school.

就

jiù

just or precisely

Tā jiù shì wǒ de lǎoshī.

Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen bù qù gōngyuán.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 2 vocabulary list?

147. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 2, not the cumulative total.

Why does this page show 50 of the 147 words?

The complete HSK 2 list is the HSK 2 pack in Lock&Learn Chinese. This page shows the first 50 words the widget deals, enough to judge the level and to try the flashcards. In the app the pack opens with a free preview, another word unlocks daily, and Lock&Learn+ opens all 147 at once.

Is this the official HSK HSK 2 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 2 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 2 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 2 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 2 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF for the words on this page; the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the table. The complete list lives in the app.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
